parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: Instance ID. Can be obtained by calling DescribeDBInstances.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Task ID for asynchronous SQL execution.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: Region ID where the instance is located.

parameters.name: SecretArn
parameters.description:
Access credential. Created through the CreateSecret interface.

> When accessing this interface with a sub-account, the sub-account must have the UseSecret or GetSecretValue permission for this SecretArn.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb get-statement-result --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --secret-arn acs:gpdb:cn-beijing:103300:secret/testsecret-eG2AQGRIwQ0zFp4VA7mYL3uiCXTfDQbQ --database test --id 9A920F47-416A-4044-817C-7C2A72AD16D3 --region cn-hangzhou
